title: StatsPAI: A Unified, Agent-Native Python Toolkit for Causal Inference and Applied Econometrics
description: A unified, agent-native Python toolkit for causal inference and econometrics — DiD, IV, RD, synthetic control, double ML, meta-learners, BCF, causal discovery, structural, panel, spatial, and time-series — exposed through a single `import statspai as sp` entry point with a unified `CausalResult` interface.
